title: Northgate Business Credit — Opening Criteria for Each Terms Tier of Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
Each terms tier of Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) has its own entry gate. Every tier is open only to business customer profiles; the tiers differ in the minimum time in business, the 12-month spend, the organization type, the documents required, the time within which Northgate Business credit decides an application, and the wait before a declined business may apply again.

### Entry gate by tier

| Terms tier | Customer type | Minimum time in business (months) | Minimum 12-month spend (USD) | Organization type | Owner's personal guarantee required | Financial statements required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | Business | 6 | — | — | Yes | No |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | Business | 12 | — | — | No | No |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | Business | 24 | 50000 | — | No | No |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | Business | 36 | 150000 | — | No | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | Business | 60 | 500000 | — | No | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | Business | — | — | Government, public school or public university | No | No |

A dash means the tier's entry gate sets no requirement of that kind.

### Decision time and reapplication

| Terms tier | Application decided within (business days) | Wait after a decline before applying again (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 2 | 90 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 3 | 90 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 5 | 90 |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 7 | 90 |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 10 | 90 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 10 | 90 |

### Notes

- The personal-guarantee column states whether an owner's personal guarantee is required; the financial-statements column states whether financial statements are required for approval and line reviews.
- An applicant's organization type is recorded as private business, nonprofit, government, public school or public university. Net 30 Public Sector is open only to government, public school and public university organizations.
- *Hypothetical comparison:* a business 30 months in business with a 12-month spend of $60000 meets the time-in-business and spend figures of Net 30 Preferred (24 months, $50000) but not those of Net 45 Volume (36 months, $150000).
